item.title: FULL LIST: CLE Room Assignments, February 2026 Criminologist Licensure Exam
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) releases the complete list of room assignments for the February 2026 Criminologist Licensure Examination (CLE).
